boards.hardware: ESP32-S3R8, 8 MB octal PSRAM, 16 MB flash; 466x466 CO5300 QSPI AMOLED; CST9217 touch; ES8311 speaker DAC and ES7210 microphones; GPIO42 MCLK; GPIO39 display reset and GPIO40 touch reset; AXP2101 PMU; TCA9554 expander; QMI8658 IMU; PCF85063 RTC; microSD slot
boards.identify: Non-C standard board SKU 31261, native USB-C, 16 MB flash and 8-pin expansion header. Not the 32 MB 1.75C badge.
boards.flash_port: USB-C native ESP32-S3 USB on GPIO19/20; hold BOOT/GPIO0 while resetting for recovery.
boards.use: WiFi activation, platform-bound Agent voice and conversations, circular Chinese/English touch UI and ESP-NOW nearby friends
boards.notes: Use waveshare-amoled-175-wifi and platform product esp32-s3-touch-amoled-175 (id 10, enterprise 0), supplied by the developer. Hotspot Amoled175-16M-XXXX. The new firmware model has a -16M suffix to distinguish this board from the C variant legacy OTA model. Standard I2S TX plus four-slot TDM RX at 16 kHz, MIC1 slot0 mono; MIC2 diagnostic levels are not sampled. PWR remains under PMU control; BOOT starts/ends calls. Shared application behavior with 1.75C; distinct reset/MCLK pins and flash size. SD/GNSS/RTC/IMU applications and hardware AEC are not enabled. Hardware acceptance pending.
